balls.text: Bailey applies the finishing touches, finishes it with a four. Suyal hunts for a yorker, but has to settle with a full toss, which is belted away past the covers. Sweeper can't cut that off
Suyal delivers a wide yorker outside off, Bailey, who sought to initially back away, falls over and can't connect. Just on the tram-line and wide called
length again outside off, Bailey sees it clears his front leg and wallops it away to the long-off boundary
Mitch flexes his muscles, cross-bat slog in front of square on the leg side
Bailey jumps across off, goes low and bottom-edges the lap sweep towards short fine. Suyal was alert enough to follow Bailey, who hops across for a single

dug in short and climbs over the stumps, slower in pace as well as Suyal rolls his fingers across to defeat Mitch's attempted pull, but the sneak in a bye. Bailey gets the strike. The keeper has a shy at the stumps but fails to hit. No bottom-edge as replays show. That's a bye
length on middle and leg, hacked away to long-on.
very full and outside off, Mitch throws the kitchen sink at it but does not lay bat onto it
dug in short and outside off, slower in pace as well from round the wicket. Bailey borrows some power from Nadal and forehands it to cow corner
Mitch backs away, Vinay does well to follow the former with a yorker. Jerked away towards deep backward square and that's good enough for a single
full toss on off, squeezed out to the off side, that's fifty for Bailey. Mitch shakes hands with his Aussie-mate
a blow so meaty that it deserved some extra cheese and french fries to add to it. Vinay errs in length, very full and on middle and leg, Bailey gets under it and slugs it over long-on
low full toss on middle and leg, bunted down to long-on. By the time the throw comes in, they pinch a couple. Vinay broke the stumps before gathering Pollard's throw
Malinga rolls his fingers across this one outside off, Mitch has a wishy-washy dabble at it and is beaten
too full and wide outside off, fails to nail the yorker. Carved away to deep cover
slippery and outside off, squeezed down to third man. Might have been the change of pace again
mighty full on off, Johnson can only block it back to Malinga
fuller and outside off, crashed to the covers

If Axar's promotion failed the other day, Dhawan's does today. Where is Saha? Fuller and straighter, Dhawan picks it up from there and whips it straight down the gullet of deep square leg. Simple catch for Vinay. The off-speed ball pulled the wool over Dhawan and Malinga exults
tickled off the pads, fine on the leg side for a couple. Velvety stroke as opposed to power
Suchith gives this more air, Bailey nips down the track, meets the pitch of the ball and hoists it up and over long-on. Clean and efficient and the Kings XI team anthem blares in the background
looped up flat and full, jammed towards mid-off. The man at covers flings to his right and stops the ball
slid through outside off, cracked to the covers, straight to the fielder
slower and outside off, Dhawan loads up for a slog-sweep and bottom-edges it to the off side
pushed through on off, tucked away through the unmanned mid-on region
yorker at the base of middle and leg, Bailey falls over as he misses the flick. This was heading down leg, though
dragged short on middle and leg, he pulls it away to the leg-side sweeper
Malinga's radar goes haywire as he he slings a shortish ball down leg, Dhawan, a former Mumbai Indians player, helps it away to fine leg

Miller undone by Malinga.. The umpires check for a possible no-ball, just a customary check, all fine though. Slippery delivery sprayed wide outside off, Miller wants to attack it, but can only edge it thickly to the left of Tare. Change of pace, there. Key wicket for the hosts
good riposte from Malinga. Right in the blockhole on off, jammed out to the covers and Bailey sets off
Malinga does not find the yorker, slips in a full toss on the leg stump, Bailey smites it flat over square leg for his first six
much slower and outside off. No problem for Miller as he comes forward, backs away a touch, picks it and sends it whistling away past the covers. Productive over for Kings XI Punjab
another of those slower offerings outside off, Bailey steps away and drills a drive to long-off
Miller looks to pull, Pollard invests in a slower bouncer. Gets a bottom-edge that wanders in front of the covers
very full and outside off, forced down to Bhajji at mid-off
short and directed at the body, Bailey camps on the back foot and pulls it firmly through backward square leg. There is protection in the deep, though
Oh hello, Pollard says Bailey. Soft and back of a length, Bailey flat-bats it over the bowler and makes a statement

not middled, but Miller still takes a four. That's T20, that's the IPL. Angled flat on the leg stump, he ventures down the track, does not meet the pitch of the ball and drags it to the deep midwicket boundary off the inside section of the bat
flat and on the leg stump, squeezed away to deep midwicket
tossed up on middle and leg, he uses his feet and wrists it through midwicket. They steal a couple, these two are whippets between the wickets
much slower through the air outside off, he shuffles across and scoops it fine
This is the turn of Miller, he comes down the track, converts it into a full bunger and drives it to long-on in a whippy fashion
full and on off, Bailey nips down the track and gets a single down to long-on
Bailey dabs this in front of midwicket and scampers across for an ultra-quick single. That rounds off a tight, uninterrupted spell from Bhajji: 4-0-20-2
darted shortish and outside off, cracked away to the off-side sweeper
pushed through on middle and leg, worked around the corner for a single
darted flat on off as Bailey comes down the track, jammed back at the bowler
tossed up on off, spins away, he comes forward and taps it behind point for one
tossed up on middle, he sinks to one knee and laps it over towards fine leg. Neatly done
banged in short on middle, no room whatever for Miller, not in the arc to go out of the park. He swivels on the back foot, half jabs and half pulls it behind square leg
pitched up with some wobbly away movement on off, Bailey is crease-bound as he thrusts his bat defensively, poked to third man off an outer edge
banged in short with some excess lift outside off, Miller waits on it and then ramps it to deep third man
bumper on the leg stump, soars through to the keeper as Miller sinks under it. One for the over gestures the square-leg umpire
back of a length and on middle and leg, tucked to deep midwicket
Malinga strays down the leg side, Bailey glances it away fine on the leg side. Easy pickings
extra bounce from a back of a length and outside off, sliced away. But Miller can't thread the gap. The spinners have throttled Kings XI
slid through short on middle and leg, whipped towards deep backward square
floated on the off stump, worked behind square on the leg side. They hustle across for the second
flat on off, he uses his feet and clips it away to short midwicket

Vijay perishes now. Arm-ball flat and quick on middle and leg, Vijay seeks to pull it away. Not a full-blooded one, not all that well-timed, neither did he impart power to it. Suchith snaps it up the top edge at deep backward square
looped up and full on off, poked into the covers
flatter and quicker just outside off, semi swatted, semi paddled away to the backward square leg boundary
picked away off the pads and nurdled wide of short fine. He sneaks in a single
Miller chips down the track, Suchith flights it outside leg. Off the thigh and runs away to short fine
darted outside leg, Miller misses the glance. And that's a wide
back of a length and outside off, scythed over to sweeper cover
flat and quick on middle and leg, Vijay uses his feet and aims to slag it away. Drags it towards backward square leg off an inside edge
tossed up on the leg stump, he shimmies forward and nudges it behind square on the leg side
fuller and on off and middle, laced down to long-ff
darted quick on off, driven to the covers
flat on middle and leg, he looks to step down and clips it to midwicket
looped up on middle and leg, he checks his flick and chips it in front of midwicket
shortish and widish outside off - pressure release- he goes deep in the crease and flashes a cut past the covers. Sweeper is beaten in the deep
looped up on middle, he inches forward and blocks it back to the bowler
dragged short and just outside off, swatted away to the cow corner fence after nailing the gap between deep midwicket and long-on

whoa! This one grips in the pitch, turns away with some extra bounce. He wafts at it and is beaten. The keeper poses a question for a stumping chance. Vijay lifted his feet momentarily but grounded it in time. The TV umpire confirms it as well
Maiden IPL wicket for Suchith. Maxi gone now. This was flat and quick on off, he aims to slog it away from there.  Low-percentage cross-bat swipe. Miscues it to Rayudu at deep midwicket
pushed through on middle and leg, Maxi slog-sweeps it away to the backward square leg boundary. Vinay's dive in the deep ends in vain
short on middle and leg, half pulled and half swept behind square leg
fuller on middle and leg, milked down to long-on
low full toss on middle, clipped away to leg
picked away off the pads behind square on the leg side as this is flatter on middle and leg

Bhajji strikes in his first over, Sehwag's effort has been cut short. Pushed through quicker on off, looks like the arm-ball. Viru steps out, does not get hold of the lofted-hit, skews it in the air. Pollard settles under it at long-on. Redeems himself for the mis-field early on
low full toss on off, Vijay sinks to one knee and sweeps it away to deep backward square
nudged behind point for a single
full and straight, tucked through midwicket

Vijay is sent back but they take the single, eventually. Banged short and rises on off, catches Vijay's bat splice as he attempts a touch stroke. Played to point, where Pollard mis-fields, and gives away a single
bumpy short ball outside off, he yanks his head out of the way
back of a length and outside off, Sehwag waits on it before steering it deftly to third man. As dexterous as an old-school barber. Just a single, but still..
straying onto the pads, put away to the backward square leg boundary with another of those wristy flicks. Pure insouciance
he takes it from outside off and whips it away to the right of a diving mid-on. Very, very wristy. Viru fetches it from there and sends it to the cow corner boundary
back of a length and outside off, directed to point
inauspicious start from Malinga. Slings it down leg, Sehwag can't connect with it. As DF wrote in the preview, his bulging waistline has hampered his bowling
Vijay opens his bat-face on impact with this back-of-a-length ball outside off and guides it to Pollard behind point
fuller on middle and leg, clipped straight to mid-on
back of a length and outside off, he angles his bat and dinks it behind point
Vijay backs away and thrashes it. Shortish and widish outside off, Vijay gets his hands through the ball and gives it marching orders over the covers
pitched up and outside off, sliced in front of a forward-diving Rohit at mid-off
two bounces and into the boundary. Banged in short, sat up to be hit. Vijay pulls it firmly to the long-on boundary
on the leg stump again, this one is on the hips. Vijay does not connect with the flick. Takes it on the thigh and they stroll over for a leg bye
superb delivery from Suyal. Round-armish inswing yorker on leg, Vijay does equally well to squirt it out
shortish and outside off, Vijay stands tall and balanced as he unleashes a punchy stroke, but does not get the placement right. Straight to the covers
back of a length and outside off, flashed down to deep third man
he boings a bouncer outside off, Sehwag cant connect with the hook. Viru looks at the square leg umpire in hope of that being called a wide

banged in short and rises on the stumps. Sehwag does not middle the pull. Yet he manages to get it over the bowler and defeats mid-on and mid-off. Off the splice of the bat as Sehwag went for the fore-handed swat.
marginally back of a length and outside off, Sehwag stands in his crease, angles his bat, exploits the pace of the bowler and glides it away to deep third man
pitched up and outside off, Vijay eases into a drive after coming forward. The man at covers dives and fumbles, conceding a run, where there should have been none
back of a length and skids onto Sehwag, no room on offer here. He manages an inside edge that wanders away to the leg side as the strike is ticked over

back of a length and outside off, width on offer. Sehwag takes toll of it and clunks a cut behind square on the off-side, beats the two men stationed at backward point. Pollard at deep third had no chance of cutting that off either

What.a.shot! Straighter in line/shading onto the pads, Viru picks it up from there and deposits it, strikes the ad boards on the flush. The TV umpire has been asked to check if that was a four/six. Replays show that its a six. Sent away to the deep midwicket fence
that's the famous see-the-ball-hit-the-ball method. On a back of a length and outside off, he slashes at it. The inside edge sneaks away to the left of the keeper
good length and angling away outside off, Vijay meets it with an open face and taps it in front of point
back of a length and on the hips, Sehwag wristily flicks it backward of square leg after hopping up
Pawan shortens his length outside off and gets it to rise alarmingly, Sehwag gets his noggin out of the way
top strike from Viru. Too full and outside off - right in Viru hitting zone - he cracks an on-the-up drive and sends it over the covers
similar length and skids on off, tucks Viru up for room. He jabs it defensively to the covers
dug in on a back of a length and rises on top of off, Sehwag quells it to the off side after getting on top of the bounce
back of a length and on the hips, tucked away to the right of mid-on now. A successful diving save from the fielder
low full toss and duly put away, with help from Corey's sloppy work at square leg. Vijay twirls his wrists, Anderson dives across, misses the ball and gives away a four. Vijay in good touch
Vinay bends his back further and delivers a short, bumpy ball. Vijay gets into a good positon and nails a pull in front of square on the leg side
on a good length and outside off, Vijay presses forward to drive it to mid-off, albeit feebly
straighter in line, Vinay drags his length back a smidge, Vijay mis-times the flick in front of midwicket
pitched up with some teasing away movement outside off, Vijay stalks it before letting it pass
Kings XI Punjab seal their first win of the season! Banged in short as Suchith nips down the track, beaten on the pull as the ball got big on him

End of a serial-bombing of an innings from Bhajji. Anureet congratulates him. He elicits tremendous applause from the crowd as he walks back. Maxi pats him as well. On a length and outside off, carved into the hands of deep point
full and outside off, crashed straight into the covers. Bhajji throws his head back in disappointment
length on the leg stump, slower ball, Bhajji goes deep in the crease and mauls it over the deep midwicket boundary
angled outside off from round the stumps, Bhajji squeezes it away past the covers
he charges down the track, takes it on the full and drills it down to long-off
He comes down the track, takes it on the full and drags it towards cow corner off the inside section of the bat
lowish full toss on off, pushed down to long-off
near yorker, squeezed out to mid-off. Overthrow, but just a single
tossed up, Suchith races down the track and goes inside-out over the covers
on a length and pushed through on middle, he sinks to one knee and slog sweeps it over long-on. Good connection from Suchith
Suchith backs away, takes it on the full and powers it away to the long-off fence
fastest fifty by a Mumbai Indians player. Full and outside off, sliced in front of point. If only the top order had contributed
full toss outside off, Suchith carves it away to sweeper cover
low full toss on off, pushed into the covers
fifth six for Bhajji. Length outside off, Bhajji wades into it and clobbers the attempted slower ball over long-on. Into the stands. Biggest of the lot
off-side wide, just past the tram-line
he shortens his length outside off, Bhajji throws his bat at it and gets an outside edge that runs away towards deep  third man. Anureet runs across and hauls the ball in. Sharp work
swing and a miss to a length ball outside off
yorker on off, pushed down to long-off
three succesive sixes. He goes bang, bang, bang! Anureet misses the yorker again, low full toss, which is clubbed over the deep midwicket boundary
Bhajji goes bang bang! Dug in short, Bhajji pulls and dispatches it over the deep midwicket boundary
Bhajji goes bang! Anureet misses the yorker, full on the stumps, Bhajji gets under it and smashes it over long-on
sliding across Bhajji on a length, past the flashing blade
slower yorker at the base of middle, dug out to the leg side
errs in line, leg-side wide
Suchith backs away outside leg, Mitch follows him with a short ball. Suchith gets a decent chunk of wood onto it as he half pulls and half jabs it over long-on
dug in short and outside leg, following Suchith, who was backing away. He swings and misses
mighty full at the base of the leg stump as Suchith backs away, near yorker. Yet, he still digs it out through cover-point
darted full and just outside off, toe-ends the drive to long-off
on a good length and well outside off, went low and swatted away towards midwicket
Bhajji takes on Mitch and clears the rope. On a length and outside off, Bhajji ventures deep in the crease and slaps it over sweeper cover. He races to 20 off 6
fuller and around off, Suchith gets under it and smashes it over mid-off for four
another yorker, he gets an inside edge to the keeper
yorker outside off, Suchith can't dig it out

caught and bowled, but that's a high full toss. The square leg umpire puts the hand up and siganals. Bhajji looks to go big but can only skew it back to the bowler off a top edge. Dhawan's appeal is turned down immediately. No-ball
back of a length and outside off, Bhajji rocks back and cuts it away to the deep point boundary. Vijay, the sweeper can't cut that off
fuller and outside off, Bhajji attacks it and slices it over short third. He wants to have some fun here
Dhawan attempts a slower ball and drifts it down the leg side, Bhajji can't glance it away
well, some cheer for the Mumbai supporters. Full and outside of, he gets under it and lifts it over mid-off, who is in the circle
Suchith misses this one and wears it on the pad. It doesn't matter even if that would crash into the stumps. Pitched outside leg
arm-ball, slashed away to the off side

If Maxi doesn't get you, Miller will. Axar gives this some air, Pollard aims to loft it away and holes out to Miller at long-off. Definition of a dolly. In case you are interested, the asking rate is 18.78. Pollard skied it off the base of the bat

In the air and through the hands of Maxi. Flat and outside off, Pollard backs away a touch and carves it in the air. Maxi at sweeper rushes forward and dives but can't cling on and the ball leaks into the boundary
full and outside off, cracked to sweeper cover
pushed through, nearly chipped back at the bowler
pitched up on off, right in the hitting zone of Pollard. The big West Indian gets under it and pummels it up and over long-on. He launched that into the Mumbai night sky
slower ball and deceives Pollard. Pollard is way too early into a lash and the ball passes the stumps
tight line outside off, teases Suchith again. Drives and gets beaten again
pitched up and outside off, he chases and gets beaten
length and on off, Pollard hoicks it away over midwicket
short again from Mitch, Suchith steps away, exposes all three stumps but can't slice it away. Bounces over the stumps

Rayudu has to depart now. This was short and sliding across Rayudu, who had initially made room to go over the covers. He makes a meal of the shot and nicks it through to Saha. Poor, poor batting from the hosts. Saha takes it at head height

shortish and hurries on off and middle, 144ks, Rayudu looks to chop it to the off side. He manages an inside-edge that sneaks away past the leg stump. Mitch has his hands on his head. Rayudu survives.
back of a length and on off, Rayudu hangs back and blocks it back to Mitch
back of a length and outside off, Rayudu reaches out and glides it to point with an angled bat
good length delivery skids on off, Pollard manages an inside-edge onto the pad. He takes off for a speedy single
banged in short on the leg stump, Pollard gets into a tangle, but gloves it away to leg
pitched up and outside off, sliced away in front of square on the off-side
low full toss on off, which is whipped away to long-on
Rayudu takes a step out, Dhawan fires a yorker, poked to third man off an outside edge
Rayudu backs away, Dhawan pushes this outside off, he reaches out and flashes it up and over a leaping Mitch at mid-off
pitched up and tails in on off, slower ball. Pollard steps out and misses the flick as he is rapped on the front pad. Jumping out of the crease may have saved him
fuller and on off, Pollard extends his arms and lifts it over the bowler's head. Long-off hunts it down and keeps it to a single
darted short on the leg stump,  off the inner edge and wanders in front of the covers. Axar rushes forward and across to collect the ball, effects a direct hit, and concedes an extra run
half-track on the leg stump, swatted away to deep midwicket

Has another batsman been stumped? TV umpire comes into play. Axar loops this up outside off, Rayudu comes down the track and misses the big blow. He loses his balance and does a near 360 degress, but just about manages to drag his bat in
lowish full toss, punched down to long-on
slid through outside off, he seeks to cut it away. Has to settle with a chop onto the ground, bumps over to the man at the covers
overpitched outside off, Pollard leans into a drive and directs it through the covers. There is protection in the deep, though
aha! There comes the lifter. Banged in short and rises on the leg stump, directed at the arm-pit. He hops up and fends it off the glove, pace like fire
fuller and slanted across off, Pollard opts for caution and flags it through to Saha again
nice and tight - on a good length and moving away in the air. Pollard takes a Pollard-like stride forward before letting that pass
on a good length and on the fourth-stump line, Pollard inches forward and punches it into the covers
pitched further up and on off, Pollard clicks forward and drives it to mid-off, finds the fielder
slid through short, punchily blocked back to Axar
pushed through and milked down to long-on
defended on the off stump

Mumbai slump further to 25 for 4. Corey is down the track, Axar pulls his length back a bit and fires it outside off. Corey can't connect with, Saha can't connect with it properly either. The ball brushes his gloves, pops out and disturbs the woodwork. Corey is short, he is stumped. As our feedbacker Sidharth chimes in: was Corey watching Man Utd game there?
Miller almost pulls off a spectacular catch. Chipped over the covers. He runs across from long-off, dives forward, the ball sticks, but pops out once his elbow hits the ground
flat on the leg stump, Corey misses the flick, outside leg I guess. They sneak a leg bye
on a good length and outside off, Corey bends his knee and lofts it up and over the covers, not much power packed in that, though. He sorta sliced it
Corey is down the track again, Sandy delivers a bouncer, that travels to Saha after beating the batsman on the pull
on the pads, turned to mid-on
Corey tees off! Runs down the track, sizes up a length ball and smokes the pants off it. Lifts it over mid-off to open his account with a four
straighter in line, draws Corey forward into a defensive push to the off side
pitched up and on off, he comes forward and pushes it to mid-on. Gets on the bike and motors across for a single
leg stumpish, Corey can't quite work it to the leg side. Mitch's half-appeal is shot down, heading down leg
pitched up and swings in on middle, Corey blocks it to mid-on
fuller and on middle and leg, patted towards mid-on
banged in short and lifts on off at 146.7ks, Corey gets a hostile welcome. He somehow fends it off to the off side

Mitch has his man! He leaps off his feet and celebrates. This was on a length and on off, hint of inward movement. Finch goes for a low-percentage slog across the line and misses. Mitch pegs the off stump back
he generates some inswing straightaway to rap Finch on the pad, but this was going down leg
fuller on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side
awayswinger now, Rayudu pokes, zips past the outer edge

a huge shout for lbw. Big inswinger from Sandy, catches Rayudu on the front pad as he misses the defensive push. Was there an inside-edge onto it, Rayudu gestures that he managed a snick onto it. Perhaps, that saved Rayudu. Looked to smash middle and leg
drifting onto the pad again, Finch still can't put it away
on a length and outside off, not-a-pullable length. Yet Finch goes for it and only meets with a whole lot of thin air. Hmm, what was Sandy appealing for?
on a length and rushes onto Finch to foil his attempted flick and strike him on the pad. But this was snaking down leg
dug in on a back of a length and outside off, keeping Rayudu on the back foot. Punched and he finds point
fullish and outside off, Rayudu wants to lash it over the off-side. But can't take advantage of the free-hit. Skews it to mid-off
back of a length and outside off, he hangs on the back foot and blocks it to the off side. No-ball for transgressing the bowling crease
back of a length and outside off, punched to point

Thanks for coming, Aditya Tare.. He nips down the track, Anureet is smart enough to shorten his length. The ball hits the splice of the bat as opposed to the bat hitting the ball. Spoons it through to M Vijay at the covers, he moves to his left and grasps it. Anureet is pumped after drawing the error from Tare
Anureet ventures short, bumpy ball rises on off. Tare does not control the pull, goes off the upper-edge over midwicket
back of a length and skids on off, he hangs back and punchily defends it to mid-on
good length ball on off, Finch does not move his feet much and pushes it back to Sandy
Sandy drags his length back, gets it to climb alarmingly, mis-hit pull over square leg
pitched up and outside off, driven past the outstretched left hand of the bowler. Mitch is quick onto the ball, half-tumbles and loses his balance. The pair sneak a single
on a length and around off, Finch camps in the crease, sets up his tent and tucks it straight to midwicket
on a back of a length and curves in on off, he skews it away backward of square leg off an inside edge. Tare did not read  the movement
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped and he finds the man at midwicket
that's a poor delivery! Short and sits up outside off, Finch takes the gift.. stands talll and punches it through cover
comes forward and pushes it towards cover, off the outside half of the bat. Tight bowling this by Anureet
he punches it over the point fielder off the back foot, not entirely in control of that shot, but gets a couple to deep point
jaffa! This one swings away from a fuller length and beats the outside edge! Finch wasn't really forward and was looking to drive, plays inside the line
tight line around off stump. He pitches it on a length and gets it to come in a touch, Finch defends it down the pitch
he floats it up outside off as well, Tare plays for the inswing but there is none, gets a thick outside edge to third man
keeps it wide outside off, Tare has to stretch to reach it but doesn't hit it off the middle, takes a single as the ball rolls to the left of point
this one doesn't come in at all! It's wide outside off and swinging away, Finch looks to drive it on the up and inside edge to deep backward square leg
floats this wide outside off, drawing Tare forward. The batsman slices it down to third man to get off the mark
full and swinging in and it has some pace as well, the batsman punches it straight to mid-on

superb delivery. This is beautifully bowled by Sandeep! It pitches on a length outside off and jags back in sharply, enough to beat the inside edge of the bat and strike Rohit on the back pad. The umpire waits for a bit before raising his finger. Rohit was looking to play it to the leg side but did not account for the movement.  Unbeaten on 98 last game, out for a duck this time!
pushes it outside off and gets that inward movement, enough to mess with Rohit's attempted drive. He gets an inside edge towards mid-on
